authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular furniture; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. West cabinet and counter run; unbranded and identity-free. Bank bounds are composition envelopes: generate submodules, not a solid block. Target bounding dimensions 0.6m wide x 0.91m high x 3.8m deep. Materials: laminate-warm-neutral. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
